EX-99.1 2 tecx-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Tectonic Therapeutic Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights • Reported favorable safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetic (“PK”) results from the single ascending-dose portion of the TX2100 Phase 1a clinical trial in healthy adult volunteers; FDA granted TX2100 Fast Track designation for Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (“HHT”) in September 2026 and cleared the Investigational New Drug (“IND”) application in August 2026 for the planned Phase 1b clinical trial • Dosed first patient in the ALPINE Phase 2a clinical trial of TX45 in pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (“PH-ILD”) in October 2026, with interim topline results expected in the second half of 2027 • TERRA Phase 1b clinical trial of TX2100 in hematologic-support-dependent HHT expected to initiate by year-end 2026, with interim topline results expected by year-end 2027, and in parallel, the TIDAL Phase 2 clinical trial in moderate-to-severe HHT expected to initiate in early 2027 • Topline results from the APEX Phase 2 clinical trial of TX45 in pulmonary hypertension associated with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (“PH-HFpEF”) are anticipated by the end of January 2027 • Cash and cash equivalents of $234.7 million as of September 30, 2026, including approximately $22.3 million in net proceeds raised from an at-the-market offering for the three months ended September 30, 2026, is expected to provide cash runway into Q1 2029 WATERTOWN, Mass., November 5, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE)-- Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc.

We are also approaching a critical milestone for TX45, with topline results from our APEX Phase 2 trial in PH-HFpEF anticipated by the end of January 2027.” Recent Business Highlights • Announced Favorable Phase 1a Safety, Tolerability and PK Results for TX2100 in Healthy Adult Volunteers: In September 2026, the Company announced favorable safety, tolerability and PK results from all six planned single dose cohorts of TX2100 administered intravenously and subcutaneously in the Phase 1a Part A clinical trial in healthy adult volunteers.

Upcoming Milestones • TX45 APEX Phase 2 Clinical Trial Ongoing with Topline Results Expected by the end of January 2027: The global, randomized, placebo-controlled 24-week APEX Phase 2 trial is ongoing, evaluating subcutaneous TX45 in patients with PH-HFpEF, including an enriched population with combined pre- and post-capillary pulmonary hypertension (CpcPH).
Topline results are expected by the end of January 2027.

• TX45 ALPINE Phase 2a Clinical Trial Ongoing with Interim Topline Results Expected in the Second Half of 2027: The open-label, multinational, 16-week ALPINE Phase 2a clinical trial is ongoing, evaluating subcutaneous TX45 in patients with PH-ILD.
Interim topline results are expected in the second half of 2027.

• TX2100 TERRA Phase 1b Clinical Trial Expected to Initiate by Year-End 2026 with Interim Topline Results Expected by Year-End 2027: The TERRA Phase 1b clinical trial is an open-label, multinational trial in hematologic-support-dependent HHT patients that is expected to initiate by year-end 2026.
Interim topline results are expected by year-end 2027.

Tectonic anticipates that, based on current operating assumptions, its cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2026 will provide a cash runway into Q1 2029, including through the anticipated Phase 2 topline readouts of TX45 in PH-HFpEF and PH-ILD, and through anticipated significant clinical milestones in the TX2100 development program.
